test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the pair of letter-clusters which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two sets of pair of letter-clusters given below. Both pairs of letter-clusters follow the same pattern.

ADK ∶ FIP

LPQ ∶ QUV
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a68c1af0dbbc4fcc5267f2fbb49bf406f028ffb99bd566f222c0447cc8011ab.png] 

**Logic: 'Addition of 5 to the positional value of each alphabet'.**

**ADK ∶ FIP →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5eb5d989dcffa02f6b78e9cf2093112142e02478dfed74979dbc468a8e339585.png] 

**LPQ ∶ QUV →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dec1d862b6883c241a6f28e068e2908769bbea9db674d0b7852ab37fcca3e289.png] 

Checking all the given options:

1. MOR ∶ RTW →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3357f063d2043c03cbf8414afc6346b6ecd75b80995b597ee06307bf036ce436.png] 

2. JKL ∶ LKJ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90887967edf7e35fa48f6aeab52e0e2b282d5042753cbb6051c941bc807ce7aa.png] 

3. GHM ∶ KNQ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38eac5ee4901193c5f2674311a0d0eab90c5814ef4901f8f3ba3adef565437ec.png] 

4. PQT ∶ QTP →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496b43c788b3ae060721add006920775ab231079ab59072340455068ed77ddb0.png] 

Here,** '****MOR ∶ RTW'** follows the same pattern as the given pair of letter clusters.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
